comparison.objective: Adjust a cabinet hinge’s side cam until door reveals are even, then close and release; candidate registers two proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Screwdriver-driven eccentric adjustment with close-to-check feedback versus loosening separate mount screws, translating and holding a sensor, then retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Closed reveals differ ≤1 mm, each 3–6 mm, flush ≤0.6 mm, no sag, released 1 s; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center sensed states retained 3 s.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest calibration record, but it tests rotary cam adjustment and door closure, not bimanual slide-and-lock registration at two actuator endpoints. Candidate lacks numeric tightening drift, screw torque, and exact hardware geometry.
